reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — User-controlled input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to host variable, which is used in URL construction at line 45. Although DNS resolution and isNonPublicAddress check occur, the hostname string itself is not validated/whitelisted. Attacker can specify arbitrary hostnames that pass initial IP checks but may exploit DNS rebinding or time-of-check-to-time-of-use vulnerabilities. The sink expression constructs URLs with unvalidated user input.

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter assigned directly to host variable
Sink: URL constructed with host parameter passed to openStream()
